summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Terms Agreement for the issuance of $500 million of 4.850% Notes due 2031 and $500 million of 5.350% Notes due 2036, sold to underwriters led by J.P. Morgan Securities LLC. This is a routine debt offering — a plain-vanilla investment-grade note issuance under an existing shelf registration — not a special situation. The filing specifies optional redemption terms, interest payments, and maturity dates. No change of control, strategic restructuring, or event-driven action is disclosed. The only watch item is typical secondary market trading of the notes after pricing.
